title: The Health Fund’s Behavioral Health Initiative
overview: The Health Fund's behavioral health grantmaking serves to improve access to effective mental health and substance use disorder (SUD) services for Michigan residents, serve populations experiencing significant health disparities, and strengthen the behavioral health system, including infrastructure, workforce development, technology, and sustainability planning. The 2026 cycle is a transition year, welcoming applications through the Healthy Kids Initiative, Healthy Aging Initiative, and a separate, one-time Behavioral Health RFP. This competitive round will focus on advancing promising work currently supported, as well as high-impact investments to address critical needs in the behavioral health ecosystem that affect all Michiganders. The application process requires a concept paper (which was due March 30, 2026). Applicants who submitted a concept paper by the deadline will be informed by May 5 if they are being invited to submit a full proposal. Full applications are due June 1, 2026, and grants will be announced September 15, 2026. Show More
